examples.title: Example 1: Initializing Particles with Circular Shapes
examples.description: This example demonstrates the basic usage of particle animations by initializing particles with circular shapes.

examples.title: Example 2: Initializing Particles with Images
examples.description: This example demonstrates the basic usage of particle animations by initializing particles with images.

examples.title: Example 3: Changing Motion Trajectories with the Particle Disturbance Field
examples.description: This example demonstrates how to change the motion trajectories of particles by applying disturbances through the particle disturbance field.

examples.title: Example 4: Adjusting the Emitter Position
examples.description: This example demonstrates how to adjust the position of the particle emitter through emitter().

examples.title: Example 5: Creating a Ring Emitter
examples.description: This example describes the basic usage of creating a ring emitter.

examples.title: Example 6: Updating the Ring Emitter
examples.description: This example describes the basic usage of updating the ring emitter of a particle animation.

examples.title: Example 7: Setting the Ripple Field and Velocity Field
examples.description: Starting from API version 22, the ripple field and velocity field can be set for particles. This example shows how to use the rippleFields API to set the ripple field of particles to produce a ripple effect. The velocityFields API is used to set the velocity field of particles, so that the velocity specified by the velocity field is added to the original velocity of particles.
